description: Override the colour profile and rendering intent of placed images (Object > Image Color Settings)

profile.description: A profile name from the image's profile list (an unknown name is refused with the list), or "USE_DOCUMENT" for Use Document Default

renderingIntent.description: Rendering intent; USE_COLOR_SETTINGS is Use Document Image Intent

target.description: Frames holding images, or the images themselves. Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: set_image_color_settings
title: Set Image Color Settings
